costs._note: 1.25% per side = DEX/router fee; $0.05 per side = network + priority + Jito tip (real at $20 size); price impact added from pool liquidity

skeptic._note: Veto rules. Any hit blocks the trade. Holder % excludes pools and known program accounts.

copy._note: Add Solana wallet addresses of traders you want to copy (find them on gmgn.ai / birdeye / cielo leaderboards).

shadow._note: Tracks every bought, vetoed and near-miss token for windowMin to learn if the rules are right (node bot/review.mjs).

live._note: Real money mirrors paper only while on=true AND the gate is open: gateTrades closed paper trades since gateFrom, in profit, profit factor >= gatePf. capUsd = most real money in play at once.

label: Zamah
about: Kupuje zamah kupaca, ali tek na drugi pogled posle 2 min.

lab._note: Challenger tactics. Each overlays entry/exit on the house rules and trades its own $20 paper book. All are hypotheses until the board says otherwise. config.live.follow = a key here makes real money copy that bot instead of the house desk.

talas.label: Drugi talas
talas.about: Token je već pumpao pa pao; kupuje kad se kupci vrate posle prvog dumpa.

maturant.label: Maturant
maturant.about: Tek prešao sa pump.fun krive na pravi pul (3 do 30 min star) i kupci ne staju.

veteran.about: Preživeo bar 6 h, dubok pul, miran rast. Manji dobici, manje rugova.
